def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # border column: the column of a distinct color forming a thin strip (2s)
    border=None
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    for c in range(W):
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        if len(set(col))==1 and cnt[col[0]]<=H and cnt[col[0]]<=W:  # candidate strip
            pass
    # find shape color: the color forming a small cluster that's not background/border/line
    # background = most common; border = full solid line/col of another color
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    border=None
    for c in range(W):
        col=set(g[r][c] for r in range(H))
        if len(col)==1 and next(iter(col))!=bg:
            border=(c,next(iter(col))); break
    if border is None:
        for r in range(H):
            row=set(g[r])
            if len(row)==1 and next(iter(row))!=bg:
                border=(None,next(iter(row))); break
    # shape color = remaining non-bg, non-border color
    others=set(cnt)-{bg}
    if border: others.discard(border[1])
    others.discard(8)
    shape=others.pop()
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==shape]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # choose side: line adjacent on the side with more space
    left_space=cmin; right_space=W-1-cmax
    if border and border[0] is not None:
        # draw on side away from border column
        if border[0]>cmax: col=cmin-1 if cmin-1>=0 else cmax+1
        else: col=cmax+1 if cmax+1<W else cmin-1
    else:
        col=cmin-1 if left_space>=right_space else cmax+1
    for r in range(H): g[r][col]=8
    return g
